title: 第5902章 合道境三重第5901章 可以上路了
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
苏尘这边，之前已经炼化几株大药，再加上这三个合道境四重的生命精气，差不多可以突破了。
他体内位面之力齐齐运转，如同巨大的磨盘，将这些生命精气碾碎，化为细微的粒子，滋养着每一个细胞中的位面之力。
三个合道境四重的生命精气固然磅礴无比，但被无数位面一瓜分，其实所剩无几，只能让他的修为向前推进一丝。
但是，他所差的，本来就只有这一丝而已。
二重巅峰，真正的极致。
苏尘开始冲击三重。
其实二重、三重、四重并没有什么难关，需要做的只有一件事，那就是沟通另一种合道级本质能量，淬炼自身，强化根基。
多一种，少一种，是天壤之别。
苏尘已经掌握第一本质能量，现在要准备沟通第二本质能量了。
理论上来说，混沌之中虽然充斥着六种本质能量，可它们太过狂暴，动辄形成能量风暴，让合道境避之不及，更不可能轻易沟通。
但这里不同，好歹也是一个位面，虽然早已死寂，环境却没有那么狂暴。
即使这里有本质能量粒子相互摩擦碰撞，化为恐怖的火焰，连翻云境十重都能轻易烧死。
苏尘不断尝试，他体内只有一种本质能量，对其他本质能量的排斥不算太大，突破应该不难。
“还是先离开这里吧。”
苏尘突然想到，自己杀了戚少，还有两个四重，那戚少的父亲绝不会善罢甘休，估计很快就会杀来。
突破不是一时半刻的事，还是换个地方慢慢来。
他一步跨出，瞬间远去亿万里。
跑出足够远后，苏尘盘坐，继续冲击三重。
但这次突破的速度，比他想象中要慢很多。
一个月，两个月……一年过去，苏尘毫无动静，仿佛第二本质能量在排斥他，根本不愿与他沟通。

但是，虽然他修为没有提升，可战力却上涨了。
为什么？
因为他虽然没感应到第二本质能量，但他的每个细胞都相当于一个位面，可以不断成长，没有止境。
哪怕这个细胞取自于低阶位面，但经过他孕育，未来也未必不能成为高阶位面，只是需要消耗的能量是一个难以想象的天文数字。
也或许永远看不到那一天了，因为到那时候，就算抽干整个大世界的能量也不够。
但也不是完全不可能，因为还有混沌存在，那里没有物质，全是本质能量粒子，数量无穷无尽，或许足以支撑苏尘成长到极限。
这一年下来，苏尘体内的位面之力提升不少，因此即使迟迟没有突破，他也不着急，毕竟时间没有白费。
两年，三年，五年，时间飞快流逝，一眨眼已是十年过去。
苏尘终于感应到了第二本质能量。
不过，能感应到是一回事，但能不能牵引过来化为己用，则是另一回事。
这一晃，又是三年过去。
苏尘终于抽取到了第二本质能量，让其在体内完整流转一周天，这也代表着他正式踏入了合道境三重。
苏尘不由感慨，自己的突破速度，比起秦雨伯、霍宁宁等人，无疑还是不够快的。
但他没有丝毫不满，因为他进境虽慢，战力却强得可怕。
而且，进境慢，那也要看跟谁比。
content_en:
On Su Chen's side, he had already refined several great medicines before, and with the addition of these three life essences from the fourth level of Hedao Realm, he was almost ready for a breakthrough.
The power of the planes in his body moves together, like a huge millstone, crushing these life essences and turning them into tiny particles, nourishing the power of the planes in every cell.
Although the life essence of the three fourth-level Hedao realms is extremely majestic, it has been divided up by countless planes. In fact, there is not much left, which can only push his cultivation forward a little.
However, this was all he was missing.
The second level of peak, the real ultimate.
Su Chen began to attack the third level.
In fact, there are no difficulties in the second, third, and fourth levels. There is only one thing that needs to be done, and that is to communicate with another Hedao-level essential energy, temper oneself, and strengthen the foundation.
One more kind, one less kind, it’s a world of difference.
Su Chen has mastered the first essential energy, and now he is ready to communicate with the second essential energy.
Theoretically speaking, although the chaos is filled with six kinds of essential energy, they are too violent and often form energy storms, making it impossible for Hedao Realm to avoid them, and it is impossible to communicate easily.
But this place is different. It is still a plane after all. Although it has been dead for a long time, the environment is not so violent.
Even if there are intrinsic energy particles that rub and collide with each other, they will turn into terrifying flames that can easily burn even the tenth level of the Cloud-Transforming Realm.
Su Chen kept trying. There was only one kind of essential energy in his body, and his rejection of other essential energies was not too great. It shouldn't be difficult to break through.
"It's better to leave here first."
Su Chen suddenly thought that if he killed Qi Shao and two fourth-level people, Qi Shao's father would never give up and would probably kill him soon.
Breakthrough does not happen in a moment, it is better to change places and take your time.
He took one step forward and was hundreds of millions of miles away in an instant.
After running far enough, Su Chen sat cross-legged and continued to attack the third level.
But the speed of this breakthrough was much slower than he expected.
One month, two months... a year passed, but Su Chen made no move, as if the second essence energy was repelling him and unwilling to communicate with him at all.
However, although his cultivation level has not improved, his combat power has increased.
Why?
Because although he did not sense the second essence energy, each of his cells was equivalent to a plane and could continue to grow without end.
Even if this cell is taken from a low-level plane, after being nurtured by him, it may not be able to become a high-level plane in the future, but the energy it needs to consume is an unimaginable astronomical figure.
Or maybe we will never see that day, because by then, even draining the entire world of energy will not be enough.
But it's not completely impossible, because there is still chaos. There is no matter there, it is all essential energy particles. The number is endless, which may be enough to support Su Chen's growth to the limit.
Over the past year, the power of planes in Su Chen's body has improved a lot, so even if he has not yet achieved a breakthrough, he is not in a hurry. After all, his time has not been wasted.
Two years, three years, five years, time flies by, and ten years have passed in the blink of an eye.
Su Chen finally sensed the second essential energy.
However, being able to sense it is one thing, but whether it can be pulled over and used for one's own use is another matter.
In this flash, another three years have passed.
Su Chen finally extracted the second essential energy and allowed it to circulate completely in his body for a week, which also meant that he had officially entered the third level of the Hedao realm.
Su Chen couldn't help feeling that his breakthrough speed was undoubtedly not fast enough compared to Qin Yubo, Huo Ningning and others.
But he was not dissatisfied at all, because although his advance was slow, his combat power was terrifyingly strong.
Moreover, if entry is slow, it also depends on who you compare with.
